name: event-tickets
description: Free tickets, RSVP, paid tickets, attendees, check-in, seating and event emails for the event-calendar plugin.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code, for example USD or EUR. Tickets are free for now; paid tickets will use it.

sender_name.title: Sender name
sender_name.description: Signs the emails sent to attendees, for example the name of your organisation. Leave empty to sign with the site name.

confirmation_text.title: Confirmation message
confirmation_text.description: Extra text added to every confirmation email, for example how to find the entrance. Leave empty to add nothing.

default_capacity.title: Default number of tickets
default_capacity.description: Pre-filled when you add a ticket type to an event.

retention_months.title: Keep attendee details for (months)
retention_months.description: Names and email addresses are erased this many months after the event ended. Ticket counts stay.

site_url.title: Site address
site_url.description: Address of the site, used for QR images in emails when the event address is a path only

schema_slug.title: Event content type
schema_slug.description: Leave empty to use Calendar event and any older Event type. Or name one content type.
